pocket_gallery.gui.title: Pocket Gallery
pocket_gallery.gui.open_button.tooltip: Import images from a folder, museums, photos or wallpapers (Pocket Gallery)
pocket_gallery.gui.search.museums: Artist, style or subject, e.g. Monet, Baroque, harbor
pocket_gallery.gui.search.photos: Optional words, e.g. Alps, snow, Paris
pocket_gallery.gui.museum.tooltip: Which open-access collections to search: Art Institute of Chicago, The Met, Cleveland Museum of Art, SMK (National Gallery of Denmark) and paintings on Wikimedia Commons. Only public-domain paintings (and Japanese prints at the Met) made up to %s are shown. Change the year in Settings.
pocket_gallery.gui.browse.tooltip: Pick an artist, art movement or subject
pocket_gallery.gui.browse.title: Browse classic art
pocket_gallery.gui.topic.tooltip: Nature and architecture photos (Wikimedia Commons), space images (NASA), vintage color photos, prints and posters (Library of Congress) and wallpapers (Wallhaven, Pixabay). Words typed in the search box narrow the topic.
pocket_gallery.gui.topic.title: Photo topics
pocket_gallery.gui.pixels.tooltip: Minecraft look for this image: shrink it to a fixed number of pixels per block (16x = like vanilla paintings, 32x/64x = sharper). Off keeps the original resolution.
pocket_gallery.gui.colors.tooltip: Reduce this image to a small palette (no dithering) for a hand-pixeled look. All keeps every colour.
pocket_gallery.gui.apply_look.tooltip: Give every selected image the pixel look of the image shown here
pocket_gallery.gui.source_filter.tooltip: Pocket Gallery: show only your paintings imported from museums, photos, wallpapers or the folder. 'Other' = paintings made another way.
pocket_gallery.gui.long_side.tooltip: Long side of new paintings in blocks. The short side follows the image's aspect ratio.
pocket_gallery.gui.crop.tooltip: ON: center-crop images to the painting's block ratio (no stretching). OFF: stretch the whole image.
pocket_gallery.gui.click_hint: Click: select - Shift+click: select range - Right click: preview
pocket_gallery.gui.preview_hint: Click an image to select it and see a preview with the painting size it will get.
pocket_gallery.gui.settings.title: Pocket Gallery Settings
pocket_gallery.settings.pixabay_key.tool: Only needed for the Pixabay wallpaper topics. Log in at pixabay.com and open pixabay.com/api/docs: your key is shown under 'Parameters'.
pocket_gallery.settings.source_prefix.to: Names start with [Museum], [Photo], [Wallpaper] or [Folder], so Immersive Paintings' 'Yours' tab (sorted by name) groups paintings by where they came from.
pocket_gallery.settings.latest_year.tool: Only artworks finished in or before this year are shown, which keeps modern art out. 1925 covers everything up to late Impressionism.
pocket_gallery.settings.default_look: Default pixel look for new images
pocket_gallery.settings.default_look.too: Pixel look every image starts with. You can still change it per image in the gallery's preview panel.
